title: Conditions: 只要…就, 只有…才, 除非, 一旦, 万一, 要不是
description: As long as, only if, unless, once, what if, and 'if it weren't for'.

points.title: 只要 … 就 …: as long as
points.summary: 只要 (zhǐyào) A，就 B = A is enough for B (a sufficient condition).
examples: {只要|zhǐyào}{每天|měitiān}{练习|liànxí}，{你|nǐ}{的|de}{中文|Zhōngwén}{就|jiù}{会|huì}{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{好|hǎo}。
As long as you practise every day, your Chinese will keep getting better.

points.title: 只有 … 才 …: only if
points.summary: 只有 (zhǐyǒu) A，才 B = A is the only way to B (a necessary condition). Don't mix with 只要…就.
examples: He'll only come if you go and invite him.

points.title: 除非 … 才 / 否则 …: unless
points.summary: 除非 (chúfēi) A，才 B = only if A. 除非 A，否则 / 不然 B = unless A, B.
points.body:
- **除非**你道歉，我**才**原谅你.
- **除非**下大雨，**否则**我们明天一定去.
examples: {除非|chúfēi}{下|xià}{大雨|dàyǔ}，{否则|fǒuzé}{我们|wǒmen}{明天|míngtiān}{一定|yídìng}{去|qù}。
Unless it pours, we're definitely going tomorrow.

points.title: 一旦 … 就 …: once
points.summary: 一旦 (yídàn) A，就 B = once A happens (usually serious / irreversible), B.
examples: Once you've decided, don't regret it.

points.title: 万一: what if, in case
points.summary: 万一 (wànyī) = in the unlikely (bad) case that …: 万一…怎么办?
points.body:
- **万一**下雨了怎么办?
- 带上伞吧，**万一**下雨呢.
examples: {万一|wànyī}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}{怎么办|zěnme bàn}？

points.title: 要不是 …: if it weren't for
points.summary: 要不是 (yàobúshì) A，B = if it weren't for A, B would have happened (A really happened).
points.body: - **要不是**你帮我，我一个人肯定做不完.
examples: If it hadn't rained, we'd have got there long ago.

notes: 只要 pairs with 就 (只有 pairs with 才).
都 doesn't pair with 只要.
还 doesn't pair with 只要.
questions.translation: As long as you work hard, you'll definitely learn it well.

questions.prompt: （　）{每天|měitiān}{练习|liànxí}，{你|nǐ}{的|de}{中文|Zhōngwén}{就|jiù}{会|huì}{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{好|hǎo}。
notes: 除非 pairs with 才 / 否则.
只有 pairs with 才, not 就.
questions.translation: As long as you practise every day, your Chinese will keep getting better.

notes: 都 doesn't pair with 只有.
也 doesn't pair with 只有.
questions.translation: Only with lots of practice can you speak well.
He'll only come if you go and invite him.

questions.prompt: {除非|chúfēi}{下|xià}{大雨|dàyǔ}，（　）{我们|wǒmen}{明天|míngtiān}{一定|yídìng}{去|qù}。
notes: 才 goes after the subject (我们才…) and pairs with 除非 for 'only if'.
questions.translation: Unless it pours, we're definitely going tomorrow.

questions.prompt: What does 「{除非|chúfēi}{你|nǐ}{道歉|dàoqiàn}，{我|wǒ}{才|cái}{原谅|yuánliàng}{你|nǐ}。」 mean?
notes: That would be 即使…也不.

questions.translation: Once you've decided, don't regret it.

questions.prompt: What does 「{这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{病|bìng}{一旦|yídàn}{发现|fāxiàn}，{就|jiù}{要|yào}{马上|mǎshàng}{治疗|zhìliáo}。」 mean?
{我们|wǒmen}{没|méi}{带|dài}{伞|sǎn}，（　）{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}{怎么办|zěnme bàn}？
questions.translation: We didn't bring an umbrella — what if it rains?

notes: 千万下雨 = 'be sure to rain'.
questions.translation: Take an umbrella, just in case it rains.

questions.prompt: （　）{你|nǐ}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}，{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|ge}{人|rén}{肯定|kěndìng}{做|zuò}{不|bu}{完|wán}。
notes: 不是你帮我 needs 而是 / 就是.
要是你帮我…做不完 is a contradiction.
就是你帮我 = 'it's you who helps me'.
questions.translation: If you hadn't helped me, I'd never have finished on my own.

questions.prompt: What does 「{要不是|yàobúshì}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒmen}{早|zǎo}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}。」 mean?
notes: It did rain — 要不是 assumes the fact.
It didn't rain is wrong — it did.
